RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel is not evidence of discrimination. For director-level roles, leadership, political acumen, and stakeholder engagement—such as the successful candidate's extensive public consultation experience—often outweigh technical credentials or tenure. Additionally, a two-week wait for municipal HR feedback is standard bureaucratic timing, not an indication of foul play. 

Raising gender without concrete, documented proof will appear unprofessional, damage your standing in regional municipal networks, and eliminate future opportunities with this employer. Instead, send a polite follow-up inquiring purely about constructive feedback on your interviews to learn how to position yourself better for upcoming executive openings.
